department_identity.magazine_title_as_printed: BEYOND THE BLUE PRINT: Engineering Solutions to Nigeria’s Electrical, Energy, & Technological Challenges

vision.text_as_printed: To become a centre of excellence in Electrical and Electronics Engineering education, research and innovation, producing highly competent, creative and globally competitive engineers capable of addressing technological challenges and contributing to sustainable national development.

mission.text_as_printed: To provide quality engineering education through effective teaching, practical training, research and innovation; develop technically competent and ethically responsible graduates; and advance knowledge and technological solutions that meet industrial and societal needs.

national_anthem.text_as_printed:
Nigeria, we hail thee,
Our own dear native land,
Though tribe and tongue may differ,
In brotherhood we stand,
Nigerians all, are proud to serve
Our sovereign Motherland.
Our flag shall be a symbol
That truth and justice reign,
In peace or battle honour'd,
And this we count as gain,
To hand on to our children
A banner without stain.
O God of all creation,
Grant this our one request,
Help us to build a nation
Where no man is oppressed,
And so with peace and plenty
Nigeria may be blessed.

university_anthem.text_as_printed:
Hail ATBU,
The fountain of knowledge,
The citadel of hope,
A cradle of opportunities,
A bedrock of technology,
Where excellence is norm,
In unity of purpose,
My ATBU.
Committed to academic excellence,
Leadership and freedom,
Equal opportunity,
And respect for diversity,
We are research leaders,
Producing graduates,
Who are worthy in character
And learning.
On the way to excellence,
You stand as a sure guide,
For quality and greatness,
Abubakar Tafawa Balewa University,
My ATBU.

student_profile.designation_as_printed: Overall Best Graduating Student of the Faculty of Engineering
student_profile.message_as_printed:
Assalamu alaikum warahmatullahi wabarakatuh.
First and foremost, all glory and gratitude belong to Almighty Allah, whose grace and mercy made this achievement possible. Being named the Overall Best Graduating Student of the Faculty of Engineering is a privilege I do not take for granted.
I dedicate this achievement to my late parents, whose discipline, values, and sacrifices continue to shape my life. I pray that Allah grants them Jannatul Firdaus.
My heartfelt appreciation also goes to my brothers for their unwavering financial and moral support, and to Alhaji Aliu Abdulkabir, CEO of Matrix Oil and Gas, whose scholarship foundation played a significant role in my academic journey.
I sincerely appreciate our lecturers for their dedication, guidance, and commitment to shaping us into better engineers and individuals. To my friends and course mates, thank you for the encouragement, shared experiences, late-night studies, and support throughout the five-year journey. You made the challenges of engineering more bearable, and I will forever cherish the friendships we have built.
Finally, to my fellow graduands, Class of 2025, congratulations on this remarkable achievement. May Almighty Allah guide our paths, make our future endeavours successful, and grant us greater opportunities to make meaningful contributions to society.
Thank you.

goodwill_message.committee_as_printed: 43rd EEE Balewite Dynamo Final Year Committee
goodwill_message.text_as_printed:
It is with joy and gratitude that I congratulate the 43rd EEE Balewite Dynamos on reaching the end of this journey.
As Provost Marshal of the Final Year Committee, my work was to help things run: raising funds, coordinating, writing letters, and encouraging others to keep going. None of it would have meant anything without the people who showed up.
Our Final Year Week showed what this class can do. We moved from Corporate Day to Costume Day, to Sports Day, to Garri Day, and ended with the Mega Hiking. Each day tested our energy and our unity, and each time we came through..
To the Executive leadership and every member of the Final Year Committee, thank you for your time, patience and support. To our lecturers, thank you for the knowledge and discipline that shaped us.
As we leave ATBU for new roads, I wish every Dynamo good health, success and good character. Wherever we go, let us carry this department's name with pride and keep the bonds we built here.
Congratulations, Dynamos.
